subject: Privilege ownership attestation + SCIM snapshot request (AegisCare)
messages:
From: Ari Patel <ari.patel@aegiscare.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Venkataraman <maya.venk@aegiscare.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Initial SCIM delta + privilege ownership ask

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. As we move through the SIG intake for our SOC 2 readiness window, security needs a short package from Redwood that proves how user provisioning and entitlement ownership are tracked. Two asks to unblock our audit: 

1) A SCIM delta extract covering 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-22 showing add/modify/remove events (csv is fine).
2) A simple mapping from role -> owner (email) and an attestation statement we can attach to our control owner workbook.

Can you confirm whether the SCIM history will include the service-account role changes and if you can include SAML assertion sample(s) for login events? We want to show evidence that service accounts are scoped and that owner remediation flows exist.

Appreciate a timeline — our SOC 2 auditor wants the package by Nov 30.

Best,
Ari
Director, Information Security
AegisCare

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@aegiscare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial SCIM delta + privilege ownership ask

Ari —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything requested. Quick notes and proposed plan: 

- SCIM delta: we can export the scoped delta CSV (will include system user/service-account flags). Expect delivery by EOD Nov 25.
- Role -> owner mapping: Laura will prepare a signed XLSX with owner emails and last-attested date.
- SAML assertion samples: we have anonymized assertion logs for the date range and will include three redacted samples for interactive + service account flows.

Two clarifying questions: 
1) For the attestation text, do you want Redwood to sign a one-line control statement ("Redwood verifies ownership and can provide change logs...") or a brief paragraph describing our owner remediation process?
2) Any restrictions on how you ingest the CSV (we can provide alternate column mappings if your intake tool expects particular headers).

I'll route the exports through our secure share (Drive link) and mark the SAML samples as redacted. If Nov 30 is the deadline, we'll target Nov 25 delivery so you have time to attach to the auditor packet.

—Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@aegiscare.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial SCIM delta + privilege ownership ask

Ari / Jordan —

Uploading the draft artifacts now. Summary of attachments and what they contain: 

- aegiscare_scim_delta_20261123.csv (SCIM event feed: timestamp, userId, username, changeType, roleList, serviceAccount:true/false)
- privilege_owner_roster_20261125.xlsx (role, team, owner_email, last_attested_date, notes)
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (3 redacted assertions; replaced PII with <REDACTED>)

A couple of implementation notes: 
- Service-account role changes are marked in the CSV via the serviceAccount column and by a role prefix "svc_".
- For owner attestation, our process requires role owners to verify changes within 7 business days; the roster includes the audit log link and the approval timestamp where available.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAegis-SOC2 (permission granted to ari.patel@aegiscare.com).

If you want a short attestation paragraph for your workbook, I've drafted one below; Jordan can sign if that's acceptable.

[Draft attestation]
"Redwood Inference confirms that the attached role-to-owner mapping reflects the state of role ownership as of 2026-11-25. Role owners are notified of pending privilege changes and have seven business days to accept or escalate changes; change events are retained in audit logs and are available upon request."

LMK if you want wording adjusted.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Trust & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Ari Patel <ari.patel@aegiscare.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Venkataraman <maya.venk@aegiscare.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial SCIM delta + privilege ownership ask

Thanks — this looks good and the files arrive cleanly. A few quick follow-ups from our audit team after scanning the artifacts: 

- Can you confirm retention period for the SCIM delta events and whether deleted accounts are preserved in the archive?
- The auditor also asked for a single SAML assertion that includes the AuthnContext comparison (we saw two samples but need one that shows the context level). If you can extract that specific sample and indicate the UTC timestamp, that'll close the gap.

If you can drop those by EOD Nov 30 we'll be able to complete the evidence packet. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Ari
Director, Information Security
AegisCare
